messages:
Lina (AE): Starlake just escalated to their CIO. POC blocked: VPC peering flaky, egress throughput much lower than bench, and procurement asking for a month-to-month pilot quote instead of annual commit. They want an exec bridge this afternoon.

Owen (Presales): I'll own pricing. Quick ask: what's their expected tokens/day and peak RPS? Procurement asked for a 60k tokens/day example and 200 reqs/min peak.

Tara (SRE): I looked at the peering logs. TCP retransmits between their VPC and our egress NAT are spiking during bursts. On throughput: when bursting >150 rps, p95 climbs. Suspect MTU mismatch or TCP window tuning. Can run a controlled canary after we confirm network settings.

Noah (Security): For procurement: they want confirmation of data-in-transit and egress routing. If they require IP allowlist + dedicated egress path we can offer Dedicated pool with a fixed egress IP block. Also need to confirm if they want BYO-VPN or transit via our partner.

Vera (Legal): If they want month-to-month pilot with BYO-VPN or dedicated egress we need a scoped addendum for networking responsibilities. I can fast-track a template but need the technical spec (IP ranges, cert rotation cadence).

BridgeBot: Bridge created: https://bridges.redwood/BR-9022. Tentative 15:30 PT. Use /bridge confirm.

Lina (AE): Owners: Tara = perf + canary; Owen = pilot pricing; Noah = egress/network security options; Vera = addendum draft. Can someone draft a concise one-liner for the exec invite?

Owen (Presales): One-liner: "Run short network canary to validate egress throughput, confirm VPC peering fixes, and present a month-to-month pilot pricing option to close the POC."

Tara (SRE): Starting canary (3-node dedicated egress path) now. Command: `./net_canary --target starlake --concurrency 180 --duration 300`. Will post short results in 12m.

Noah (Security): I'll prepare the egress architecture diagram and IP allowlist template: https://vault.redwood/artifacts/starlake-egress-diagram.pdf. If they want fixed egress IPs, we can reserve a /28 for Dedicated pool.

Vera (Legal): Draft addendum ready for review: https://legal.redwood/drafts/starlake-network-addendum. Please comment before I send to their counsel.

Tara (SRE): Canary tail: [2026-03-23T22:12Z] p95=1.05s kv_miss=8% (baseline); [2026-03-23T22:20Z] p95=360ms kv_miss=4% (after MTU/tuning + dedicated egress path). CSV: https://perf.redwood/runs/prf-starlake.csv

Lina (AE): Scheduling bridge and sending invite with one-liner + artifacts. Post-bridge plan: if canary holds, offer 30-day month-to-month pilot on Dedicated egress with option to convert to annual commit. Noah/Vera/Owen to finalize materials pre-bridge.

BridgeBot: Bridge BR-9022 closed: notes uploaded.

Lina (AE): Post-bridge summary: CIO accepted the canary numbers and wants pilot contract. Owen to post final pilot quote tomorrow AM; Vera to send signed addendum. Good work team.
